rules.title: Evaluate company-produced information before relying on it

source_refs.abstraction_note: Defines the professional evidence requirement, not the future organization facts.

applicability_conditions: The audit team intends to use company-produced information as audit evidence.
evidence_requirements: Evaluate accuracy and completeness or relevant controls.
Evaluate whether the information is sufficiently precise and detailed.
forbidden_assumptions: Do not treat management output as reliable solely because it agrees with an unsupported summary.
acceptable_handling: Perform corroborating procedures or document why evidence remains insufficient.

rules.title: Respond to doubts about evidence reliability

source_refs.abstraction_note: Defines a response when records conflict or authenticity is doubtful.

applicability_conditions: Evidence appears modified, inconsistent, or otherwise unreliable.
evidence_requirements: Identify the reliability concern and perform an appropriate additional response.
forbidden_assumptions: Do not resolve a conflict by selecting the record that is most convenient.
acceptable_handling: Seek corroboration, revise procedures, or leave the conclusion unresolved with follow-up.

rules.title: Evaluate control deficiencies individually and in combination

source_refs.abstraction_note: Provides the evaluation factors, not a conclusion for a future scenario.

applicability_conditions: Control deficiencies have been identified during an integrated audit.
evidence_requirements: Consider reasonable possibility, potential magnitude, and interactions among deficiencies.
forbidden_assumptions: Do not conclude severity solely because a misstatement did or did not occur.
acceptable_handling: Document the evaluation and escalate conclusions supported by the combined evidence.

rules.title: Establish fair and reasonable price before award

source_refs.abstraction_note: Defines the award-file requirement, not a supplier or price fact.

applicability_conditions: A simplified acquisition is ready for award.
evidence_requirements: When only one response is received, document the supporting basis.
forbidden_assumptions: Do not treat a catalog price alone as sufficient proof of fairness and reasonableness.
acceptable_handling: Use a permitted comparison or research basis and record it in the file.

rules.title: Retain support sufficient for management review

source_refs.abstraction_note: Defines minimum documentation concepts, not future file content.

applicability_conditions: Quotation or offer information supports a simplified acquisition decision.
evidence_requirements: Retain the relevant price, delivery, supplier-contact, and other support.
forbidden_assumptions: Do not omit the basis for a non-price selection factor.
acceptable_handling: Prepare a concise reviewable record linked to the decision.

rules.title: Apply the appropriate quality assurance and acceptance boundary

source_refs.abstraction_note: Defines the general commercial quality-assurance boundary, not product facts.

applicability_conditions: Commercial products or services are tendered under a contract with relevant quality requirements.
evidence_requirements: Identify the contract requirement and available contractor quality evidence before disposition.
forbidden_assumptions: Do not accept an item merely because delivery occurred.
acceptable_handling: Accept conforming support, or document hold/follow-up when evidence does not establish conformity.
